Based on the image, here is a detailed description of the security camera interface:

**The Camera Feed (Main View)**
*   **Room/Location:** The feed is currently displaying **CAM 01 – ESCENARIO** (which translates to "CAM 01 – STAGE" or "SCENARIO"). 
*   **Status:** The screen is currently **completely black**, indicating the room is dark, the camera is disabled, or there is no light source. A red "REC" dot is visible in the top left corner of the feed, along with a timestamp reading **1007-10-12**.

**Visual Effects & Overlay**
*   **CRT/Scanline Effects:** The display features a heavy **green phosphor monochrome aesthetic** typical of old CRT monitors. There are visible horizontal scanlines running across the entire screen, giving it a flickering, analog texture.
*   **Vignette:** The edges of the monitor screen are slightly darker than the center, simulating the curvature and depth of an old tube television.

**Camera Map (Right Side)**
*   **Layout:** On the right side of the screen, there is a schematic **floor plan map** of the building. It is rendered in bright green lines against a black background.
*   **Details:** The map shows various rooms divided by walls. Small numbered squares (representing camera nodes) are placed in different locations on the map.
*   **Selection:** Camera **01** is currently highlighted with a solid green fill, indicating it is the active camera being viewed.

**UI Buttons & Controls**
*   **Camera Selection Grid:** Below the map is a grid of buttons numbered **01 through 12**, allowing the player to jump directly to specific cameras.
*   **Bottom Controls:** At the very bottom, there is a text-based control line: `[C] CERRAR · [A/D] CAMBIAR CAMARA · [1-9] SELECCION RAPIDA`. This indicates controls for closing the camera, cycling through cameras, or quick selection.
*   **Left Sidebar:**
    *   **Top:** Displays "NOCHE 01 – OBJETIVOS" (Night 1 - Objectives) with a checklist including items like "Encontrar" (Find), "Reparar" (Repair), etc.
    *   **Bottom:** Shows status bars for "LINTERNA" (Flashlight) and "RESISTIR" (Resist/Endure), along with a compass indicating "N" (North).

**Is it FNAF-style?**
**Yes, absolutely.** This is a classic **Five Nights at Freddy's (FNAF)-style camera system**. 
*   It uses the same static camera feed layout.
*   It features the iconic green-tinted CRT visual style and scanlines.
*   It utilizes a map for spatial awareness alongside a button grid for switching cameras (a hallmark of the FNAF UI).
*   The objective-based survival horror context (Night 1, objectives, stamina/resistance bar) fits the genre perfectly.
